title: Dulce base shootout in Lazar's briefing documents

tellings.quote: the the idea that there had been this shootout down below in in a base at Dulce and that 64 special forces guys got killed because they had arms and they were not allowed to have arms and the gray shot them

plain: Secret briefing papers described a shootout in an underground base at Dulce, New Mexico, where 64 special forces soldiers were killed by gray aliens because they carried weapons they were not allowed to have. That is how the researcher Grant Cameron sums up what Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked at a secret site called S-4 near Area 51, the Air Force's hidden Nevada test base, says he read in the papers he was shown there. Cameron gives it as a summary of Lazar's account, without naming any other source.
